complete_examples.text: The influence of vehicle speed and ground surface type on WRRN is investigated, and it shows that the vehicle speed is positively correlated to WRRN–SPL and the extremum of WRRN–SPL will be decreased by the reduction of the effective flow resistivity within bounds.
